$comment: BSuite one-shot entity ownership map. Source: docs/20260227-dry-one-shot-architecture-v1.04A.md §1 + docs/20260423-cross-app-write-audit-v1.00W.md V5–V10 + docs/20260427-ownership-map-ratification-v1.00W.md (PHASE-3c). Each entry uses EXACTLY ONE of: `owner: <app>` (single canonical write surface) OR `writers: [<app>, ...]` (multi-writer admin co-ownership, @bsuite/dry-lint@0.2.0+). owner + writers together is a schema error. readers = apps that may .select() but never write. owner=`shared` is reserved for audit-trail/append-only sinks + user-self-write + multi-app capture flows (see Item 3 enumeration in ratification doc). owner=`all` = explicit event-sink (e.g. bi_metrics, audit_log).

tenant_role_permissions.$comment: CRM7-local Layer-3 org-admin permission-override table (migration `20260301200800_create_tenant_role_permissions.sql`). Configured in CRM7 Organisation Settings → Permissions; overrides default role→action mapping from roleMappingService. Not consumed cross-app.

custom_pages.$comment: ADR-0001 (2026-05-01) ratified: CRM7 sole authoring surface (`src/pages/settings/custom-page-*.tsx`). Per ADR-0003 each consumer app ships its own read-only `CustomPageRenderer`. Replaces the prior `tenant_page_layouts` slot which was atomically dropped 2026-04-29.

custom_page_revisions.$comment: Optional version-history surface for custom_pages. 7 columns. The former `custom_page_blocks` entry was a misnomer — blocks live in `custom_pages.layout` jsonb, not a separate table.

wage_calculation_snapshots.$comment: Audit V8 — append-only audit sink shared by CRM7 and R80 until unified `create_append_only_audit()` helper ships (combined-GTO-plan N-2).

apprentice_rate_configs.$comment: Audit V8 — ownership formally ambiguous (P1-5). Accepting CRM7 + R80 writes until owning module formalised.

award_rate_cache.$comment: Fair Work award-rate cache. Declared in both crm7 migration `20260228210000_create_award_rate_cache.sql` and R80.3 `20260301_award_rate_cache.sql`; per those migrations both apps read AND write — CRM7 populates via the sync-award-rates cron/edge fn, R80.3 reads/writes via `src/services/fairworkApi.ts` + `utils/calcBridge.ts` + `services/payrollTaxService.ts`. `shared` = multi-app write; readers list documents the two consuming apps.

invoices.$comment: WS3 invoicing. Table created by crm7 migration `20260423140000_ws3_invoices.sql`. Multi-writer: CRM7 authors invoices via `src/lib/billingEngine.ts` + `lib/invoicing/`; R80.3 generates invoice runs against them via `src/services/invoicingService.ts`. Both are canonical write surfaces (@bsuite/dry-lint@0.2.0+ writers shape).

invoice_line_items.$comment: Sibling of invoices — created by crm7 migration `20260423140000_ws3_invoices.sql`. Multi-writer: CRM7 (`billingEngine.ts`, `lib/invoicing/renderInvoicePdf.ts`) and R80.3 (`services/invoicingService.ts`) both insert/delete line items. (Cross-cutting audit initially proposed owner=r8; corrected to writers after confirming CRM7's billingEngine write surface — owner=r8 would flag legitimate CRM7 writes.)

invoice_runs.$comment: R80.3-owned per migration `20260701100000_r80_invoice_runs.sql`; sole write surface is `src/services/invoicingService.ts`. CRM7 reads for billing/reporting handoff.

invoice_run_invoices.$comment: Join table for invoice_runs↔invoices, R80.3-owned (migration `20260701100000_r80_invoice_runs.sql`; written by `src/services/invoicingService.ts`). CRM7 reads for handoff.

funding_offsets.$comment: R80.3-owned per migration `20260726090000_funding_offsets.sql` (explicit `Ownership: this table is R80.3-owned` header); written by `src/services/fundingOffsetsService.ts`. CRM7 + BSU read funding-offset expected/received splits for quotes, billing, and reporting.

tenants.$comment: PHASE-3c (@bsuite/dry-lint@0.2.0): multi-writer per docs/20260427-ownership-map-ratification-v1.00W.md Option C. BSU owns platform-level tenant CRUD; CRM7 tenant-management edge function performs tenant admin operations on its own org hierarchy under RLS. Other apps remain readers.

user_tenants.$comment: PHASE-3c (@bsuite/dry-lint@0.2.0): multi-writer per docs/20260427-ownership-map-ratification-v1.00W.md Option C. BSU owns membership join writes; CRM7 tenant-management edge function manages org membership (invite/approve/remove) under RLS. Other apps remain readers.

team_invitations.$comment: Added per docs/20260427-ownership-map-ratification-v1.00W.md Item 2 — sibling of team_members. WS-G admin RLS migration `20260426000000_team_members_admin_rls.sql` shipped policies for this table; align ownership with team_members.

teams.$comment: Added per docs/20260427-ownership-map-ratification-v1.00W.md Item 2 — sibling of team_members. WS-G admin RLS migration `20260426000000_team_members_admin_rls.sql` shipped policies for this table; align ownership with team_members.

profiles.$comment: User-self-write pattern — every app upserts the current user's own row (auth.users-keyed, RLS enforces self-only). Not a cross-app data ownership concern.

leads.$comment: Migration owned by CRM7 (`20260301100300_create_leads.sql`). Public capture flows through `crm7/supabase/functions/lead-capture/` (called by braden public site + BSU LeadForm). BSU `/developer/website` admin surface mutates lead status. All three apps have legitimate writes; per audit V5 the original BSU-direct insert was rerouted through the edge function.

lead_activities.$comment: Co-managed alongside leads — same authoring surface set.

tasks.$comment: Two distinct table declarations (braden 20260228 + crm7 20260226) with different schemas. RLS enforces tenant isolation. Both apps legitimately own writes within their own scope.

r7_candidates.$comment: r7_* prefix is the production naming convention used in conduit migrations (supabase/migrations/20260304040000_add_rls_to_r7_tables.sql et al). Replaces the speculative `conduit_candidates` slot per CONDUIT-SCHEMA-GAP decision 2026-05-06: 0 production code references the conduit_* names; 16 r7_* tables exist live and are referenced by conduit submodule code, RLS, and migrations.

r7_offers.$comment: Job offer extension — readable by CRM7 for placement creation handoff.

r7_onboarding_instances.$comment: Onboarding state — readable by CRM7 to gate placement record creation on completed onboarding.

bi_metrics.$comment: Event sink — every app emits write events; BSU aggregates.

projects.$comment: Co-owned by CRM7 + Throughput per architecture doc §1.
